item.description:
# Challenge yourself by taking your practice to the water!

## Duration
2 Hours and 25 Minutes

## About
This option gives you the best of both worlds! You get to participate in our Rise & Shine SUP Yoga class followed by our Boston Harbor Paddle tour. 
SUP Yoga classes are for all levels and are 75 minutes in length from our on land lesson to savasana. No SUP experience is required to participant but some yoga experience is recommended. This will then be followed by another 60 minute leisurely paddle around historic Boston Harbor!


Classes include all equipment. If you choose to bring your own equipment please reserve a BYOB space.                
	
			
Please read your confirmation email for detailed directions and meet up location information.

## Whats Included:
Stand Up Paddleboard (SUP) , Paddle, Anchor, Life Vest (PFD), 65 minute Yoga class, 10 minute on water & on-land lesson, 60 minute guided paddle tour.

## What to Bring:
Bathing Suit, Yoga pants/shorts, Tank/Tee, Long sleeve (weather depending), Towel, Water bottle, Sunscreen, Sunglasses, NO COTTON!
item.booking_notes:
Thank you for joining us on the water! We are super excited to have you in class!

##Meet Up:
Trailer is located at 1-3 Binford Street, Boston MA
Directions: If you are driving a vehicle: Please enter at the 45 Binford Street entrance. For AM classes: parking is $5 on Sat/Sun. For PM classes, please note that discounted parking begins at 6:00 PM and is $8 so please do not enter before this time. Upon entering the lot, drive to the furthest left corner of the lot, closest to the Harbor Walk indicated as our “Meeting Area.”   You will see the SUP YO trailer, please park here.

If you are commuting from South Station: Please walk PAST the Gillette Dock to the parking area where your instructor will meet you with the equipment. Once you pass the dock, it is about 200 feet to the parking lot entrance on your left. You will walk south on the Harbor Walk so that the water is on your right, parking lot on your left)

Please arrive 15 minutes before your event begins and be ready and willing to help prepare gear for your class. This is a team effort :)

**What to Bring:**
Bathing suit, Yoga pants/shorts, Tank or long sleeve shirt , Sweatshirt or Fleece (weather depending),  Change of clothes,  Water bottle, Dry bag (optional), Camera, Hair elastic, Sunscreen,Sunglasses, NO COTTON!

##What's Included:
Stand Up Paddleboard (SUP), Paddle, Anchor, Life Vest (PFD)

If you cannot swim you will be required to wear a personal floatation device.Classes are generally 75 minutes in length from our on land lesson to returning to shore. Please be mindful and respectful of everyone’s time and pay close attention to the on land lesson so we may get you on the water as soon as possible and safely to our on water studio location.

If you have any questions at any time, if you are lost, or can't find us, please call or text 978-361-5394. If you have any other questions, feel free to get in touch.

We look forward to meeting you outside,

The SUP YO Team
www.supyoadventures.com
978-361-5394
item.cancellation_notes:
If you need to cancel or make a change to your reservation, you must do so more than 48 hours before the class/paddle start time to receive a credit/exchange/transfer. No credits/exchanges/transfers are issued for changes made within 48 hours of the class/paddle start time. NO REFUNDS will be issued for a customer-requested cancellation.   

If class is canceled by SUP YO due to inclement weather (thunderstorms, high winds or other severe conditions), limited attendance or other reason, you may exchange the value of your ticket to another class/event or you may request a refund. Refunds will only be honored for cancellations made by SUP YO  and must be requested within 24 hours of class. Outside of 24 hours, a credit may be issued. 

Credits are valid for 1 year from date of issue.

Late Policy
If a student is more than 10 minutes late for class, the class will begin without said student and that student will forfeit his/her ticket.  No shows = no refunds.This protocol has been put in place for the consideration of both our customers and our instructors. We value your time as well as ours, so if it’s safe to do so, we will always try to keep our scheduled/booked classes. Keeping an open line of communication between our staff and our customers is always our goal so that customers are fully aware of our weather protocol. Our intention is always to share the events we have curated for you.  We love what we do – and we want you to experience it, too – so we will always aim to get you out on the water, SAFELY.


For a copy of our policies and procedures visit here: https://www.supyoadventures.com/privacy-policy-2/
